Plan a family trip with Arcadia: how it works

Arcadia Tourism organises private, family-friendly trips to Kazakhstan, Russia, Poland, Uzbekistan and China for travellers from the Gulf and the wider Arab world, with Arabic- and English-speaking guides, halal-friendly planning and one point of contact from the first message to the flight home.

Which destination suits your family?

  • Kazakhstan: the easiest summer escape, visa-free for GCC citizens, 25°C mountain weather near Almaty and modern Astana. See tourism in Kazakhstan.
  • Russia: imperial palaces, the Hermitage and the White Nights; visa-free for Gulf citizens. See tourism in Russia.
  • Poland: a green European holiday at reasonable prices, from Krakow's old town to the Zakopane mountains. See tourism in Poland.
  • Uzbekistan: Samarkand, Bukhara and Khiva on the Silk Road, Muslim-majority and visa-free for GCC citizens. See tourism in Uzbekistan.
  • China: the Great Wall, Beijing, Shanghai and Disneyland, plus Canton Fair and Yiwu for traders. See tourism in China.

Still undecided? Read the best time for family travel to each destination and private driver vs full tour package: which is better for families.

What every Arcadia program includes

  • Hotels chosen for families: connecting rooms or suites, central locations, breakfast included.
  • A private car with driver for all transfers and day trips, and an Arabic- or English-speaking guide.
  • Pre-booked tickets for the main attractions, so you skip the queues.
  • Halal restaurant planning and prayer-time-aware itineraries.
  • Visa guidance and documents, 24/7 WhatsApp support during the trip.

How booking works

  1. Send us your dates, number of travellers and children's ages on WhatsApp +7 706 400 7561 or through the contact page.
  2. Within 24 hours you receive a day-by-day program with a fixed price.
  3. Confirm with a deposit; we book hotels, transport and tickets and send the vouchers.
  4. Our local team meets you at the airport and stays in touch throughout the trip.

Browse current packages on offers and reservations, and avoid the usual pitfalls with common mistakes when booking a family tour.

Frequently asked questions

Do you organise trips for groups and companies?
Yes. We arrange group trips, incentive travel and student programs to all five destinations.

Can we customise a program?
Every program is built for your family; tell us the pace you want, the activities your children enjoy and your budget.

Which languages do your guides speak?
Arabic and English in all destinations, plus the local language.

How early should we book?
Six to eight weeks before summer and Eid travel, three to four weeks in other seasons.
